items.description:
The Crazy Store Cycad Centre is a discount and variety retailer, part of the long-running Crazy Store chain of general merchandise shops found in shopping centres across South Africa. The store carries a broad range of everyday goods, from household items and gifts to party supplies, toys, craft materials and balloons, giving shoppers a wide selection of small, affordable purchases without needing several separate stops around town.

It trades from Shop 010 in Cycad Centre on General Maritz Street in Bendor Park, Polokwane, and serves local residents and shoppers looking for affordable variety retail, gifts and party essentials close to home, whether they are planning a celebration or simply topping up household supplies.

Turf Lodge is a lodge offering accommodation close to the University of Limpopo in Mankweng, within easy reach of the campus and the surrounding community. The lodge has built up a sizeable following locally, with thousands of followers and well over a thousand visitor check-ins recorded on its own page, and guests who have left feedback have mostly recommended a stay there to others.

It trades from the corner of University Road and Houtbosdorp Road in Mankweng, Polokwane, and suits travellers, students, visiting academics and family members of students who need a place to stay in the area, whether for a short visit or a longer stay.

Wesley Methodist Church is a Methodist congregation serving Polokwane Central and the surrounding community. As part of the wider Methodist Church of Southern Africa, the congregation offers a place of worship for its members, bringing together people from the area for regular services and fellowship, and continuing a Methodist presence that has long been part of Polokwane's community of churches.

The church is located at 74 Biccard Street in Polokwane Central, and it is a good fit for anyone in the area looking for a Methodist congregation to join for worship, fellowship or a one-off visit while passing through the city.

AliSom Cycad Centre is a cell-phone and accessory retailer and telecommunications service provider, trading as part of the AliSom network of stores confirmed on the company's own store locator. The branch stocks mobile phones and accessories and offers telecommunications services to walk-in customers, from its position among the other mobile-network and electronics stores in the same shopping centre.

It operates from Shop 8 in Cycad Centre, on the corner of General Maritz Street and Outspan Drive in Bendor Park, Polokwane, and is a convenient stop for anyone in the area needing a new handset, accessories or help with their mobile service plan.

Babirwa Travel is a travel agency based in Sterpark, serving residents of Polokwane and the surrounding area who need help planning and booking their trips. As a travel agency, it handles the kind of bookings travellers typically can't easily arrange themselves, from flights to accommodation, and it operates alongside a handful of other travel agencies in the same part of town, giving local travellers a nearby, personal alternative to booking everything online themselves.

The agency trades from 27 Munnik Avenue in Sterpark, Polokwane, and suits travellers who prefer working with a local agent to arrange their flights, accommodation or other travel bookings in person.

Baby City Mall of the North is the Bendor branch of the Baby City retail chain, stocking baby and maternity products, toddler gear and toys. The wider Baby City range on offer spans prams, strollers, cots, car seats, nursery furniture and accessories, nappies and baby toiletries, alongside toys for younger children, and the store's own branch listing confirms it offers Click and Collect, letting shoppers order online and collect their purchases in store rather than waiting on home delivery.

The store trades from Shop L11 in Mall of the North, on the corner of the R81 and N1 in Bendor, Polokwane, and serves parents, expectant families and anyone shopping for baby and toddler essentials in the area.

The practice includes a small team of general practitioners alongside a dedicated dental practitioner, giving patients access to both general medical care and oral healthcare at the same premises, with reception staff on hand to welcome patients and help them book appointments with the right practitioner.

BendorMed is based at 30 Bendor Drive in Bendor, Polokwane, and suits patients who want the convenience of seeing a doctor or a dentist without having to travel between separate practices across town for routine or ongoing care.

Caterlim is an earthworks company based in Futura, associated with earthmoving and earthworks-related trade in the Polokwane area. The business has built up a solid, returning base of customers who come back to it for earthmoving-related products and services, reflecting an established presence in the local earthworks and construction-support sector that contractors and operators in the area have come to rely on for their ongoing projects and equipment needs.

Caterlim operates from 35A Corundum Street in Futura, Polokwane, and serves contractors, construction businesses and other customers in the area who need earthworks-related supplies or services, whether for a single project or an ongoing operation.

items.description:
Dr Wilhelm von Ludwig is a general practitioner at Medpark Clinic on Jorissen Street in Polokwane, part of a long-standing group medical practice offering care across all age groups. His fields of interest include acute and chronic conditions, general check-ups, paediatrics and skin conditions, together with HIV, infectious diseases and TB, giving him a particular focus within the wider practice on infectious and chronic disease management.

He holds an MB ChB from Stellenbosch University, together with a postgraduate diploma in TB-HIV from the University of Cape Town, qualifications that underpin his specialised interest areas. Patients can see him at Medpark Clinic, 24A Jorissen Street, Polokwane, for general practitioner care spanning routine check-ups through to the management of chronic and infectious conditions.

The Paledi Mall store carries the chain's usual mix of women's and men's clothing, along with cosmetics and fashion accessories, giving shoppers in Mankweng a full fashion range without having to travel into central Polokwane for it.

The branch serves shoppers in Mankweng and the surrounding Turfloop area who want clothing, cosmetics or accessories, and its position inside Paledi Mall makes it an easy stop alongside a regular shopping trip to the centre.

Hungry Lion Turfloop Plaza is a quick-service restaurant focused on fried chicken and freshly prepared food, part of the wider Hungry Lion chain found in shopping centres across South Africa. The Mankweng branch has built a loyal local following, with hundreds of customers engaging with its own page and marking themselves as having visited, reflecting steady foot traffic through the outlet over time.

It trades from the Shoprite Centre at Turfloop Plaza, Erf 747, University Road, Mankweng, Polokwane, and is a convenient option for students, families and shoppers in the area wanting a quick chicken meal without leaving the centre.

Hussains Hair Salon is a hair salon offering women's hair services, including haircuts, hair colouring and hair extensions, confirmed through its current online booking listing. Clients can book these services directly online ahead of time, making it straightforward to arrange an appointment for a cut, a colour treatment or a set of extensions without having to call in or wait for an opening.

The salon trades from Shop 30 in Thornhill Shopping Centre, on the corner of Munnik Avenue and Veldspaat Street in Thornhill, Polokwane, and is a fitting choice for women in the area looking for a nearby salon for these specific hair services.

Kalapeng Mankweng Pharmacy is a retail pharmacy trading as a member of the WeCare Pharmacy Network, a group of pharmacies operating under a shared banner across South Africa. Through that network, the pharmacy dispenses prescription medication and offers everyday healthcare and wellness advice to patients who come in for scripts, over-the-counter remedies or general health queries.

The pharmacy trades from Shop 23 in the Twin City Mankweng Shopping Centre on the R71, giving patients in Mankweng and the wider Ga-Thoka area a nearby place to collect medicine and get pharmacy advice without travelling into central Polokwane. It opens Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and Saturdays from 08:00 to 14:00, closing on Sundays, so patients can plan a visit around the working week or a Saturday morning errand.

Customer reviews describe a family-run operation with a clean shop and a varied menu, with recurring praise for its chips and fish and chips over several years of trade. The takeaway trades from 379 De Wet Drive, Bendor Park, Polokwane, and suits customers after a quick, familiar takeaway meal rather than a sit-down dining experience.

items.description:
Falcon Rock Spur is the Savannah Mall branch of the Spur Steak Ranches chain, and its own listing describes juicy steaks and warm service for shoppers and locals alike. Guests can eat in at the sit-down restaurant, take their food away or order for collection, and delivery is available through Mr Delivery and Uber Eats as well as through the Spur's online ordering.

The restaurant is in Shop G37 at Savannah Mall on Grimm Street in Fauna Park, Polokwane. It is open every day of the week, so it suits a family dinner or a meal after a visit to the mall.

McDonald's Polokwane CBD is the city-centre branch of the McDonald's fast-food chain, on Grobler Street. The restaurant serves its well-known fries, burgers and chicken nuggets, along with milkshakes and soft serve, and the branch says it aims to deliver every meal fast, fresh and in a clean, welcoming environment.

Families can come in for a Happy Meal or grab a coffee at McCafe, and a drive-thru lane means customers can get lunch without leaving their car. Customers can eat in or use the drive-thru to collect their order. The branch trades seven days a week, so it suits families, shoppers and anyone passing through the CBD who wants a quick meal.

The Dental Studio is a modern dental practice focused on patient comfort, service quality and technologically advanced dental procedures. According to the practice's own website, that focus on comfort and up-to-date technology shapes how appointments are run, from routine check-ups to more involved dental work.

The practice serves patients needing general dental care in and around Bendor, working from its premises at 39 Bendor Drive, Bendor, Polokwane. It suits patients who want a dental visit handled with modern equipment and a comfortable, unhurried experience, whether that means a routine check-up, a filling or a more involved dental procedure, rather than a rushed appointment at short notice.

The Tax Shop Polokwane West provides accounting, bookkeeping, payroll and tax services for individuals and businesses. Its services include financial accounting, business advisory, the registration, maintenance and deregistration of companies and trusts, and payroll and HR processing. The firm also offers a complete outsourced solution for clients who want their books handled end to end.

The website says the team uses expert financial support and up-to-date technology to keep clients' finances in order. It is based in Polokwane and suits small business owners and entrepreneurs who want accounting and tax compliance handled for them. Visitors can get in touch through the website to talk through their needs before committing to a service.
